newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Fresh gun attack in Budapest crime spree.
newsitem.headline: Fresh gun attack in Budapest crime spree.

text.p: Budapest's spate of armed attacks on businessmen continued on Friday when an attacker shot at a casino owner and then struck him with the gun.
Police officer Gyorgy Molnar told Hungarian news agency MTI the businessman was getting out of his jeep outside his home when the masked man fired at him from a small-bore pistol.
The bullet missed its target and lodged in the door of a nearby parked car. Molnar said the weapon may then have failed, prompting the assailant to knock his victim down with his gun before fleeing.
The 52-year-old unidentified businessman was taken to hospital.

Over the past two months Budapest has been rocked by a gangland turf war that has seen more than a dozen hand grenade attacks on nightclubs and restaurants and at least four shootings, one of them fatal.
Businessman Zoltan Csapo, 56, was shot repeatedly by an attacker on a motorcycle on Tuesday.

Jozsef Prisztas, a known underworld figure, was shot dead at the wheel of his car on November 1. He has been linked to an underworld "banker", Andras Lakatos, who reportedly absconded to Mexico with large sums of underworld money.
